name: KeywordNotify
description: Sends a notification if a given message matches certain keywords or regexes
summary: Messages matching your keywords or regexes highlight and notify like mentions, and collect in a Keywords inbox tab

settings.label: Amount to keep
settings.description: Amount of messages to keep in the log

notes: Settings list keyword entries: a regular expression ("example|regex"), Ignore Case, Ignore Bots, a whitelist and a blacklist of user, channel or server IDs, and which list wins when an ID is in both ("List priority"). A message from someone else whose text, or an embed's title, description or field, matches an entry counts as mentioning you: it gets the gold mention highlight and notifies you as a mention would (in servers too, unless the channel or server is muted or you are in Do Not Disturb). Matches collect, newest first, in a "Keywords" tab of the inbox next to Mentions (at most "Amount to keep" per account): click one to jump to it, right-click to remove it, or Clear All. Messages that arrive or load after you change your keywords use the new ones.
gaps: The matched keyword isn't highlighted inside the inbox entry.
Matching messages don't add to the channel's mention count badge.
Patterns are Qt (PCRE2) regular expressions, which match JavaScript's for everyday patterns.
